[workspace]
members = ["helper", "crates/pq", "crates/custody-fs"]
resolver = "3"

[package]
name = "age-plugin-tpm-wsl"
version = "0.1.0"
edition = "2024"
license = "Apache-2.0"
description = "An age plugin using Windows TPM keys from WSL"

[dependencies]
# Offline public wrapping; Windows alone opts into seed restoration.
age-tpm-wsl-pq = { path = "crates/pq" }
age-core = "0.12"
age-plugin = "0.7"
base64 = "0.22"
bech32 = "0.11"
rand = "0.8"
# RSA public wrapping; private production operations stay in Windows PCP.
aws-lc-rs = { version = "=1.18.2", default-features = false, features = ["alloc", "non-fips", "prebuilt-nasm"] }
sha2 = "0.10"
zeroize = "1.8"
wait-timeout = "0.2"
serde_json = "1"
# Public hardware receiver primitives are doc(hidden); pin the reviewed release.
hpke = { version = "=0.14.1", default-features = false, features = ["alloc", "nistp", "chacha", "getrandom"] }
# Unify this feature to wipe the AEAD's stored key on drop.
chacha20poly1305 = { version = "=0.11.0", default-features = false, features = ["zeroize"] }
poly1305 = { version = "=0.9.1", default-features = false, features = ["zeroize"] }
hpke-sha2 = { package = "sha2", version = "=0.11.1", default-features = false, features = ["zeroize"] }

[patch.crates-io]
# Exact reviewed seed interface; source/patch hashes are retained under vendor/.
aws-lc-rs = { path = "vendor/aws-lc-rs" }
# Accepted protocol-buffer wiping and required-label refusal; exact source provenance.
age-core = { path = "vendor/age-core" }
age-plugin = { path = "vendor/age-plugin" }

[dev-dependencies]
# Public component extraction for the disposable software fixture only.
aws-lc-rs = { version = "=1.18.2", default-features = false, features = ["ring-io"] }
p256 = { version = "0.13", features = ["ecdh"] }
hex = "0.4"
tempfile = "3"

[[bin]]
name = "age-tpm-wsl-check"
path = "src/check.rs"

[[bin]]
name = "age-plugin-tpm-wsl"
path = "src/main.rs"
